snippet.title: SOMNIUS - Official Announcement Trailer - Vacuum Up Your Friends
snippet.description:
Wishlist SOMNIUS on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882630/SOMNIUS/

Vacuum up furniture, fallen enemies and even your friends in this first-person co-op extraction game for 1–6 players.
Enter collapsing dreams, rescue the Dreamer, and turn your haul into weapons or extra seconds on your team's shared timer.

Looking for your next co-op game after R.E.P.O. or PEAK? Bring your crew into SOMNIUS.
